culpritSource.quote: They solve Yuko's code and go to Tokyo Station. There, Yuko is meeting Ishikawa. The culprit is Takuto Ishikawa. He wants to protect Yuko from Hiroaki, so he killed Hiroaki. He also approached Kowata and tell the truth. Kowata felt sorry and wants to protect them, so he pretended to be cursed by Anubis to avoid testifying.

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are visiting Ancient Oriental Culture Museum to buy the famous Egyptian god keychain. When they are going to pay the keychain, the Anubis statue falls onto Hiroaki Uchida's body, and he is found dead.

victims.name: Hiroaki Uchida
victims.causeOfDeath: Blunt force trauma from the falling Anubis statue
victims.causeOfDeathZh: 阿努比斯像坠落砸中致死

suspects: Ken Kowata, Takuto Ishikawa, Yuko Uchida, and Kiyoshi Yamada
suspectsZh: 川田健、石川拓人、内田优子与山田清
